title: Undergraduate Advanced Selected Topics in Biology; Quantitative Analysis of Biological Data
description:
Prerequisite: C- or better in MATH136 or MATH141, and permission of instructor. Credit only granted for: BSCI439N, BIOL708L, or NACS728B.

Methods of analysis for time series and other data, including spatial data. Analysis methods include signal processing, statistics, and simpl modeling. Python programming is taught and used throughout the course. Topics include data smoothing, Fourier/frequency analysis, spectrograms and bootstrap error estimation.

(Sponsoring Dept.: BIOL) Applies as an upper-level laboratory course to Biological Sciences Specialization Areas: CEBG, ECEV, GENB, and PHNB. Students must pay a $40.00 laboratory materials fee.
